```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("R/00_utils/notebook_setup.R")
```

**Stage:** S6 (design matrices).
**Purpose:** document the feature families and the explicit lag construction
for the prospective endpoint E2.
**Inputs:** `output/predictions_e1.csv`, `output/design_audit.csv`.
**Outputs:** none.
**Parameters:** `P$L2`, `P$train_years`, `P$test_years`.

## Feature families (predeclared)

```{r}
fams <- names(FAMILY_FEATURES)
knitr::kable(data.table(
  family = fams,
  predictors = vapply(FAMILY_FEATURES, function(x)
    if (length(x)) paste(x, collapse = ", ") else "(month dummies only)", ""))
  , caption = "Concurrent (E1) feature families")
```

E2 uses the same families with every predictor taken at month `t-1`:
`ssi3_lag`, `spei3_lag`, `spi3_lag`, `p_ge_q_lag` and `p_ge_q_inc`
(the one-month increment of `P(Q >= q*)`).

## Check the emitted predictions

```{r}
p1 <- nb_require("predictions_e1.csv", "S7")
nb_assert_cols(p1, c("gauge_id", "date", "year", "y", "p", "family"),
               "E1 predictions")
nb_assert(all(p1$p >= 0 & p1$p <= 1), "predicted probability outside [0,1]")
nb_assert(all(p1$year %in% P$test_years), "E1 contains a non-test year")
nb_assert(setequal(unique(p1$family), fams), "not every family was fitted")

da <- nb_require("design_audit.csv", "S6")
nb_assert(all(da$n_queue_finite > 0), "a gauge has no queue feature months")
cat(sprintf("E1 prediction rows: %d across %d gauges and %d families\n",
            nrow(p1), data.table::uniqueN(p1$gauge_id),
            data.table::uniqueN(p1$family)))
print(p1[, .N, by = family][order(family)])
```

`[measurement]` Predictions are emitted only for held-out test years
(2011-2020). Features are standardized on training rows only, so no test-year
mean or standard deviation leaks into the model. Ridge penalty `L2 = 1.0`;
the intercept and month dummies are handled explicitly.
